title: Christ the King
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Christ the King means that Jesus reigns with divine authority over His people, His enemies, the nations, the church, and all creation. His kingdom is present now and will be fully revealed when He returns.
summary: Christ the King means that Jesus reigns with divine authority over His people, His enemies, the nations, the church, and all creation. His kingdom is present now and will be fully revealed when He returns.
christFocus: Jesus is the promised King who rules in righteousness, conquers His enemies, shepherds His people, and will bring the kingdom of God to its final visible fullness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture presents the Messiah as King. Jesus is the Son of David whose kingdom will have no end, yet His reign is greater than earthly politics or temporary power.

Christ’s kingship is already real. The risen Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth. He rules His church, sends His people, and reigns until all enemies are put under His feet.

His kingdom is not built by worldly force, pride, or manipulation. He reigns in truth, righteousness, salvation, judgment, humility, and holy authority.

The kingship of Christ will be fully displayed at His return. Every rival will fall, every knee will bow, and the King of kings will be seen in glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people want Jesus as helper but resist Him as King. But the Savior who forgives also rules. His grace does not leave people under self-rule.

This doctrine gives courage when earthly powers seem overwhelming. Christ is not waiting to become Lord; He already reigns, and His kingdom cannot fail.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Submit to Christ the King in every area of life. Do not reserve parts of your heart, habits, relationships, ministry, or hopes from His rule. Serve Him with reverence, courage, and joy while awaiting His visible reign.
